heading: Bulk Yard
intro: Looking for mulch, compost, soil, or rock? We carry a wide selection for both professional landscaping and home projects. Buy as little as a 5-gallon bucket or as much as a dump-truck load. Our bulk yard is open during business hours, with staff ready to help. Delivery is available. See our 2026 price list below.
If you need help calculating yardage for your project, use one of our handy volume calculators below.

faq.question: Do you deliver?
answer: Yes, we contract with a 3rd party who delivers every Friday. There is a $135 charge to deliver anywhere within a 10 mile radius of our nursery. Every 10 miles extra (or increment thereof) incurs an additional $135 charge. Their delivery trucks can hold up to 12 cubic yards of rock or 14 cubic yards of bark.

faq.question: Can I get multiple products delivered in a load?
answer: Technically yes, just keep in mind there is no way to compartmentalize your individual products when they are dumped off the truck. If they are products you are planning on mixing anyway then it might not be an issue.

faq.question: How much does 1 yd. weigh?
answer: Soil – 1800-2200 lbs. depending on product & moisture content.

faq.question: How much product will I need for my project?
answer: Every project varies. Use one of our handy calculators above to determine how many cubic yards of product you will need.

faq.question: Can I buy less than a yard?
answer: Yes, our bulk products are sold by the yard, but you can buy as little as 1/4 yd. We also sell smaller quantities by the 5-gallon bucket. Just bring in your bucket & fill with desired product for $5.

faq.question: My truck has a canopy/topper. Can you load bulk product into my truck bed?
answer: No, please remove your topper before coming to the bulk yard or make arrangements for delivery.

faq.question: Do you sell your products by weight?
answer: No, all of our bulk products are sold by the yard. When calculating your project needs, simply input your variables above and calculate total cubic yards required.
